name: wecom-autoreply
description: Opt-in, macOS: a resident WeCom (企业微信) AI bot whose replies are written by headless Claude Code, and which runs the owner's tasks with Claude Code, asking in WeCom before actions auto mode blocks. Includes wecom-cli setup and a launchd agent. The bot itself requires Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: WeCom AI bot answered by Claude Code, kept alive by launchd.
interface.longDescription: Sets up a resident WeCom AI bot on macOS: replies come from headless, tool-less Claude Code; requests for the owner become numbered to-dos pushed to WeCom; the owner can send tasks that Claude Code runs with tools, approving blocked actions from WeCom. Includes wecom-cli installation and a launchd agent. The bot itself requires Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Set up my WeCom bot to auto-reply with Claude Code.
My WeCom bot stopped replying — check it.
